title: Human Call Gateway Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the Human Call Gateway. All transports are URL + headers + body mappings (no vendor SDKs). Secrets are env var NAMES, never literal secret values. Adding a channel type = one mapper + this schema fragment + register type.

default_channel_id.description: Default channel to use when channel_id is omitted from the request. Must match an existing channel id.

timeout_ms.description: HTTP client timeout in milliseconds. Default: 10000 (10 seconds).

channels.description: List of configured notification channels. Each channel must have a unique id.

id.description: Unique identifier for this channel. Used in API requests to select this channel.

enabled.description: Whether this channel is enabled. Default: true.

slack_config.description: Slack Incoming Webhook configuration. Uses Slack's Incoming Webhooks feature.

webhook_url_env.description: Environment variable name holding the Slack Incoming Webhook URL. The webhook URL is a secret and must not appear in this config or in logs.

telegram_config.description: Telegram Bot API configuration. Sends messages via Telegram Bot API.

bot_token_env.description: Environment variable name holding the Telegram bot token. The token is a secret and must not appear in this config or in logs.

chat_id.description: Telegram chat ID (can be a user ID, group ID, or channel ID). Must include '-' prefix for groups and channels.

api_base_url.description: Telegram Bot API base URL. Default: https://api.telegram.org

feishu_config.description: Feishu/Lark bot webhook configuration. Uses Feishu's custom bot webhooks.

webhook_url_env.description: Environment variable name holding the Feishu bot webhook URL. The webhook URL is a secret and must not appear in this config or in logs.

qq_config.description: QQ (go-cqhttp / OneBot) configuration. Requires at least one of user_id or group_id. Uses OneBot HTTP API standard.

http_api_url.description: go-cqhttp / OneBot HTTP API endpoint URL (e.g., http://127.0.0.1:5700/send_msg).

access_token_env.description: Optional environment variable name holding the OneBot access token. The token is a secret and must not appear in this config or in logs.

user_id.description: QQ user ID for private message. Either user_id or group_id must be set.

group_id.description: QQ group ID for group message. Either user_id or group_id must be set.

webhook_config.description: Generic webhook configuration. Sends POST requests to arbitrary URLs. Header values that are secrets should use ${ENV_VAR} placeholders (e.g., Authorization: Bearer ${API_TOKEN}).

url.description: Webhook URL. Use this for non-secret URLs. Either url or url_env must be set.

url_env.description: Environment variable name holding the webhook URL. Use this when the URL contains secrets. Either url or url_env must be set.

method.description: HTTP method. Only POST is supported in v1.

headers.description: Additional HTTP headers. Header values can use ${ENV_VAR} placeholders for secrets (e.g., { "Authorization": "Bearer ${API_TOKEN}" }).
